high_level_description: This image is a bar chart titled "Tequila & Mezcal are Now Only Behind Vodka in the US." The chart compares the sales of various spirits in the United States for the year 2023, measured in 9-liter cases. The data source is attributed to the Distilled Spirits Council of the United States (DISCUS). Title: The title is prominently displayed at the top of the chart. It highlights that Tequila & Mezcal have surpassed other spirits in sales, ranking second only to Vodka. Bar Chart:
